ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels and 60% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, high-intensity white contiguous regions occupying the medial zones of both lobes; low-intensity dark pigmentation dominates the central peduncle area, the distal tips, and the entire trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 130 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible across the entirety of the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits more pronounced, jagged irregularities compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer-most distal tips and along segments of the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, thin, high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) observed on the dark pigmentation of the inner right lobe and lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized irregular white scarring at the junction of the fluke and peduncle; jagged, non-uniform indentation on the tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple protruding calcified organisms (barnacles) along the fluke margins, particularly concentrated on the distal tips.
